name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, and hinge forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees.
Let your arms hang straight down under your shoulders, keeping your back flat and your gaze toward the floor.
Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs, bringing your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the weights slowly until your arms are straight again.
technique_considerations: Keep your back flat rather than rounding it, and choose a weight that lets you do that.
Move your arms, not your torso; avoid jerking the weights up.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
